articles.title: Love Behind Bars: MP Jail Officer Marries Former Life Convict in Interfaith Wedding
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A woman jail official in Madhya Pradesh’s Satna has married a former inmate who once served a life sentence in a murder case, in a relationship that reportedly began inside the prison and later culminated in an interfaith marriage.

body.html:
A woman jail official in Madhya Pradesh’s Satna has married a former inmate who once served a life sentence in a murder case, in a relationship that reportedly began inside the prison and later culminated in an interfaith marriage.

According to reports, Firoza Khatoon, an Assistant Superintendent at Satna Central Jail, met Dharmendra Singh while serving as the warrant in-charge at the prison. Singh, a resident of Chandla in Chhatarpur district, was lodged in jail in connection with the 2007 murder of a councillor and the burial of the body.

During his imprisonment, Singh allegedly assisted prison authorities with warrant-related work, which brought him into regular contact with Khatoon. Over time, their professional interactions reportedly developed into friendship and later a relationship.

Singh was released around four years ago after serving nearly 14 years in prison, reportedly due to good conduct. Following his release, the couple decided to formalise their relationship through marriage.

The wedding took place on May 5 in Chhatarpur district. Reports said Singh changed his name on the wedding invitation cards to avoid social scrutiny. The ceremony was conducted according to Vedic rituals and chants.

The interfaith marriage reportedly did not receive support from Khatoon’s Muslim family members, who did not attend the event. In their absence, Vishva Hindu Parishad district vice-president Rajbahadur Mishra and his wife performed the ceremonial ‘kanyadaan’. Members of the Bajrang Dal were also present during the ceremony.

The unusual marriage has become a major talking point in the region, drawing attention for the couple’s journey from prison interactions to marriage despite social and religious barriers.

Officials, employees and even inmates associated with Satna Central Jail have reportedly extended wishes to the newlywed couple.

#MadhyaPradesh #Satna #BreakingNews #InterfaithMarriage #LoveStory

articles.title: Gonda Man Says Wife Refused to Return After Getting Hospital Job
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A marital dispute from Uttar Pradesh’s Gonda district has drawn attention after a man alleged that his wife refused to live with him after completing her ANM course and securing a hospital job, despite his financial sacrifices for her education.

body.html:
A marital dispute from Uttar Pradesh’s Gonda district has drawn attention after a man alleged that his wife refused to live with him after completing her ANM course and securing a hospital job, despite his financial sacrifices for her education.

The case is from Chapra Talla Kaurhe village under the Motiganj police station area.

Rajesh Kumar Verma alleged that he worked as a labourer in Punjab and spent lakhs of rupees to support his wife Renu Verma’s education. He claimed he sold buffaloes, sugarcane, and even arranged money through hard labour so that she could complete her ANM course.

According to Rajesh, after getting a job at a hospital in Gonda, his wife and her family began demanding that he leave his elderly parents and settle separately in the city. He alleged that when he refused, they demanded ₹10 lakh to settle the matter.

Rajesh said his father is mentally ill and his mother has lost her eyesight, making it impossible for him to abandon them.

“I studied only till Class 5. I worked as a labourer to educate my wife, but now she says she will not return home. How can I leave my old and sick parents and live separately?” he said.

He has submitted a complaint to CO Shilpa Verma demanding the return of the money and jewellery allegedly spent on his wife’s education and marriage.

Rajesh stated that he married Renu in 2001 and their gauna took place in 2018. He claimed that during her studies, she had promised to return and live with him after getting a job.

However, Renu Verma denied the allegations and accused her husband and in-laws of physically assaulting her whenever she stayed with them. She said she could not remain at her in-laws’ house for more than a few days due to alleged harassment.

Renu also rejected claims that her husband financed her studies, stating that she arranged money herself to continue her education and complete her examinations.

She said she never asked her husband to abandon his parents permanently but wanted him to stay with her in Gonda because of her job, while continuing to visit the village when possible.

Renu further alleged that her husband had assaulted her at her rented accommodation in Gonda and said complaints had already been filed at the women’s police station and SP office.

Women Police Station in-charge Anita Yadav said the matter is currently being heard at the family counselling centre. According to her, the husband wants his wife to quit her job and live in the village, while the wife is unwilling to leave her employment.

Both parties have been called again for counselling on Sunday.

#Gonda #UttarPradesh #FamilyDispute #MarriageConflict #BreakingNews

articles.title: Wedding Procession Attacked in Hamirpur: Groom Dragged Out, Beaten with Rods Over Old Rivalry
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A wedding procession in Uttar Pradesh’s Hamirpur district turned violent on Thursday evening after a group of bike-borne miscreants allegedly stopped the convoy and launched a brutal attack over an old rivalry.

body.html:
A wedding procession in Uttar Pradesh’s Hamirpur district turned violent on Thursday evening after a group of bike-borne miscreants allegedly stopped the convoy and launched a brutal attack over an old rivalry.

The incident took place near Basela village in the Rath police station area when the wedding procession was travelling from Jhinna Veera village to Banda.

According to reports, Amber, a resident of Kaitha village, along with his associates, allegedly intercepted the procession and attacked the groom, Munni Lal, his brother Jagdev, and several family members using sticks and iron rods.

Videos of the incident circulating on social media show the accused parking their motorcycles in front of the wedding vehicles before launching the assault. The groom and his brother were allegedly dragged out of the car and beaten mercilessly, while the vehicle’s windows were smashed during the attack.

The groom suffered serious head injuries, while children travelling in the car, including Rupali, Gagan, and Amrita, were also caught in the violence. Locals said panic and chaos gripped the area during and after the attack.

All the injured were rushed to the government hospital in Rath, where doctors provided first aid. Despite suffering injuries and receiving bandages on his head, groom Munni Lal reportedly continued the wedding journey in another vehicle to Banda’s Baberu area to bring the bride.

Rath Circle Officer Rajiv Pratap Singh confirmed the incident and said police immediately sent the injured for medical examination and treatment after receiving information.

Police said legal proceedings are underway based on the complaint filed by the victims. Authorities are also identifying the accused through the viral videos, and efforts are being made to arrest those involved.

#Hamirpur #UttarPradesh #BreakingNews #WeddingAttack #ViralVideo

articles.title: GRP Constable Lynched by Mob in Odisha After Molestation Allegations, Family Questions Police Inact
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A Government Railway Police (GRP) constable was allegedly beaten to death by a mob in Odisha’s Khurda district on Wednesday following allegations of molesting two young women.

body.html:
A Government Railway Police (GRP) constable was allegedly beaten to death by a mob in Odisha’s Khurda district on Wednesday following allegations of molesting two young women.

The deceased has been identified as Saumya Ranjan Swain, who had been serving as a constable with the Cuttack GRP for the past 12 years.

According to police, Saumya Ranjan was travelling with his colleague Om Prakash on official duty to meet the Railway ADG when the incident occurred.

Police said allegations surfaced that the two policemen made indecent remarks at two women during the journey. The situation reportedly escalated after their motorcycle allegedly hit a scooter carrying the women, dragging them for a short distance.

Following the collision and allegations, locals gathered at the spot and allegedly attacked the two men. Saumya Ranjan Swain was severely assaulted by the mob and later died.

The family of the deceased has alleged police inaction during the incident. His mother claimed that police personnel were present at the scene but failed to intervene or rescue him.

Deputy Commissioner of Police Jagmohan Meena confirmed that an investigation is underway. He also stated that a counter-complaint has been filed by the other side, alleging attempted rape by the deceased constable and his colleague.

Police said all angles are being investigated and further legal action will be taken based on the findings.

#Odisha #Khurda #BreakingNews #MobLynching #GRP

articles.title: Secret Arms Factory Hidden Beneath Almirah Busted in Meerut, BCA Student Among 4 Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a major crackdown, Meerut police on Tuesday night busted an illegal arms manufacturing factory operating from a hidden underground chamber beneath an almirah inside a house in Khardauni village.

body.html:
In a major crackdown, Meerut police on Tuesday night busted an illegal arms manufacturing factory operating from a hidden underground chamber beneath an almirah inside a house in Khardauni village.

The shocking discovery was made in the Incholi police station area during a joint raid by the local police and SWAT team following a tip-off from an informer.

According to police, the entrance to the illegal factory was concealed inside a wardrobe placed in one of the rooms. When officers opened the almirah, they found a tunnel-like passage leading underground, where country-made pistols were allegedly being manufactured.

Four accused were arrested from the spot, including Imran, the alleged mastermind, and Umang Thakur, a BCA student who police say was involved in supplying weapons.

During the raid, police recovered one semi-finished pistol, two ready-made country-made pistols, 36 springs, 45 barrels, and several 12-bore barrel parts. Welding machines, lathe machines, drill bits, grinders, saws, files, and other weapon-making tools were also seized.

SP Rural Abhijeet Kumar Singh said the illegal factory was being operated from a basement specially built under the cupboard inside Imran’s house.

Police said each accused had a specific role in the racket. Imran allegedly manufactured the weapons, Kuldeep acted as the main supplier, Narendra arranged customers, and Umang Thakur handled delivery and sale of pistols to buyers.

Investigators revealed that Imran had previously been jailed nearly 25 years ago for running an illegal arms factory and had once again revived his network after coming out.

Police records show that several criminal cases are already registered against the accused in Meerut and Delhi under the Arms Act.

Officials said further investigation is underway to trace the wider network and identify buyers linked to the illegal arms trade.

Notably, this is the second such case reported in Meerut within weeks. Around 15 days ago, police had uncovered another illegal weapon factory hidden beneath a bed.

#Meerut #UttarPradesh #BreakingNews #IllegalArmsFactory #PoliceRaid

articles.title: Chaos Inside Hyderabad’s Niloufer Hospital: Viral Video Shows Fight Between Patient Attendant and F
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A viral video showing a physical altercation between a female patient attendant and hospital staff inside Hyderabad’s Niloufer Hospital has triggered outrage and intense debate on social media. The incident reportedly took place inside the government-run children’s hospital in Telangana.

body.html:
A viral video showing a physical altercation between a female patient attendant and hospital staff inside Hyderabad’s Niloufer Hospital has triggered outrage and intense debate on social media.

The incident reportedly took place inside the government-run children’s hospital in Telangana. CCTV footage and mobile videos circulating online show a woman attendant confronting a female staff member while appearing to question her angrily.

In the video, the staff member is seen trying to push the woman away, following which the argument quickly turns physical. The two women are then seen fighting inside the hospital premises.

As the situation escalated, another female staff member rushed in to separate them. Moments later, additional female security personnel also arrived at the spot. The viral footage further shows multiple staff members allegedly assaulting the patient attendant during the scuffle.

Several bystanders, including a man and patients nearby, can be seen trying to calm the situation and urging the women to stop fighting.

The video spread rapidly across social media platforms, drawing sharp criticism from many users who questioned safety, professionalism and crowd management inside government hospitals.

One user wrote, “Hospitals are meant to heal people, not traumatise them further.” Another commented, “Security guards are supposed to protect patients and attendants, not become aggressors.”

Several users tagged Telangana government officials and police authorities, demanding strict action and a detailed inquiry into the incident. Some social media accounts described the episode as “protectors turning into attackers” and called for suspension of the staff involved.

However, some users argued that the full context of the incident was not visible in the clip. A few claimed the woman attendant appeared aggressive initially and said hospital staff in crowded government facilities often face difficult situations while handling patients and families.

There were also complaints online regarding overcrowding and poor hospital management, with some users alleging that patient attendants are often forced to handle responsibilities that should be managed by hospital staff.

According to reports, doctors and officials later consoled the woman after the incident. However, it remains unclear what exactly triggered the fight.

So far, no official statement has been issued by the hospital administration regarding the viral video or any disciplinary action. Police said no formal complaint has been filed in connection with the incident.

#Hyderabad #NilouferHospital #Telangana #BreakingNews #ViralVideo

articles.title: Truck Driver Goes on 6-Km Rampage After Minor Collision, Hits Auto and Flees
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dangerous road rage incident in Bengaluru has sparked concern after a truck driver allegedly drove recklessly for several kilometres following a minor collision with a car.

body.html:
A dangerous road rage incident in Bengaluru has sparked concern after a truck driver allegedly drove recklessly for several kilometres following a minor collision with a car.

According to reports, the incident began after a truck reportedly belonging to DTDC Courier lightly brushed against a car, leading to an argument between the two drivers.

Witnesses said the confrontation soon escalated, after which the truck driver allegedly sped away and drove dangerously across city roads for nearly five to six kilometres while the car driver chased the vehicle.

During the high-speed chase, the truck reportedly rammed into a roadside auto-rickshaw. Despite the collision, the driver allegedly did not stop and fled the spot in a suspected hit-and-run attempt.

Videos of the incident, reportedly recorded by the car driver on a mobile phone, have gone viral on social media and triggered sharp reactions from the public.

The case falls under the jurisdiction of the Peenya Traffic Police Station. Police have reportedly registered a case and launched efforts to identify and trace the truck driver involved.

The incident has once again raised concerns over reckless driving and increasing road rage cases in Bengaluru, with citizens demanding stricter action against dangerous driving on city roads.

#Bengaluru #RoadRage #BreakingNews #HitAndRun #ViralVideo

articles.title: ‘Run Naked for ₹5,000’: Viral Hathras Video Sparks Outrage, 5 Accused Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking incident has surfaced from Uttar Pradesh’s Hathras district, where a 27-year-old man was allegedly made to run naked through a residential locality after being offered ₹5,000. The incident took place on Sunday in Chandpa town under Chandpa police station limits.

body.html:
A shocking incident has surfaced from Uttar Pradesh’s Hathras district, where a 27-year-old man was allegedly made to run naked through a residential locality after being offered ₹5,000.

The incident took place on Sunday in Chandpa town under Chandpa police station limits. A video of the act later went viral on social media, triggering outrage.

In the footage, several individuals can allegedly be seen encouraging the man to remove his clothes in exchange for money. The man is then seen running naked through narrow lanes in front of local residents, including women, while onlookers cheer and record videos.

According to reports, one of the accused is allegedly linked to the village pradhan’s family.

Taking suo motu cognisance of the viral video, Chandpa police registered a case on May 4 under relevant sections of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), including Section 296 related to obscene acts.

DSP Sadabad Amit Pathak said a complaint was filed by a sub-inspector posted at Chandpa police station, following which police launched an investigation.

Police initially stated that one main accused had been arrested and another was absconding. Later, officials confirmed that five accused have now been arrested and legal proceedings are underway.

Authorities said the investigation is continuing and further action will be taken as per law.

#Hathras #UttarPradesh #BreakingNews #ViralVideo #ShockingNews

articles.title: Man Arrested for Allegedly Sexually Assaulting Stray Dog Near Religious Site
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Police in Uttar Pradesh’s Hardoi district have arrested a man accused of sexually assaulting a stray female dog in the Sandila area, an incident that triggered widespread outrage after a video surfaced online.

body.html:
Police in Uttar Pradesh’s Hardoi district have arrested a man accused of sexually assaulting a stray female dog in the Sandila area, an incident that triggered widespread outrage after a video surfaced online.

The accused, identified as Mohammad Safiq, was arrested by Sandila Kotwali police after investigators traced him through the viral video, which had reportedly been recorded by a local resident on a mobile phone.

According to police, the incident took place near a religious place, further intensifying public anger in the area. Following the circulation of the video, residents demanded strict action against the accused.

Police said a case has been registered against Safiq under the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act. Relevant sections of the IT Act have also been invoked in connection with the circulation of the video.

The accused has been sent to judicial custody.

Local residents expressed deep shock and anger over the incident, while the Sandila police administration assured that strict legal action would be taken and efforts would be made to ensure maximum punishment under the law.

#Hardoi #UttarPradesh #BreakingNews #AnimalCruelty #PoliceAction

articles.title: Real-Life Hero in Hyderabad: Auto Driver Rams Snatcher, Saves Woman & Helps Police Nab Repeat
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a remarkable act of bravery, an auto-rickshaw driver, Mohd Zaheer, risked his life to foil a chain-snatching attempt and helped police arrest a repeat offender in Begum Bazaar, Hyderabad.

body.html:
In a remarkable act of bravery, an auto-rickshaw driver, Mohd Zaheer, risked his life to foil a chain-snatching attempt and helped police arrest a repeat offender in Begum Bazaar, Hyderabad.

The incident took place on March 4 near Jhinsi Chowrasta, when a woman out on a morning walk with her daughter-in-law was targeted by a rowdy-sheeter, identified as Mohd Sohail.

According to police, Sohail attempted to snatch the woman’s gold chain but lost control of his scooter and fell. Hearing the victim’s cries, Zaheer—who had already crossed the spot—quickly reversed his auto-rickshaw and rammed the आरोपी’s bike as he tried to escape.

Despite being attacked with a stick, Zaheer did not back down and ensured the accused could not flee until patrolling police arrived and took him into custody. Notably, Zaheer left the spot quietly without revealing his identity or seeking any recognition.

The entire incident was captured on CCTV cameras, which later helped Hyderabad City Police trace Zaheer through his vehicle number.

In recognition of his courage, Police Commissioner V C Sajjanar honoured him at TGICCC with a commendation letter and a cash reward.

Praising his actions, the Commissioner said Zaheer’s courage sets an example of responsible citizenship at a time when many hesitate to intervene.

Police have registered a case, and further investigation is underway.

#Hyderabad #BreakingNews #HeroAutoDriver #ChainSnatching #Bravery
